The best answer is **A, equitable servitude**. The recorded plan restricts the 10-acre lot to school use for the benefit of the 90 lot owners, and buyers relied on it as part of a common development scheme, which fits an equitable servitude enforceable against later owners with notice. B is a close alternative because "restrictive covenant" is the broader term that includes equitable servitudes.
CONFIDENCE: 60
